feeds.title: Carly » style
feeds.description: Hi!! I'm Carly. I started this blog as a creative outlet during my freshman year at Georgetown University. In this blog, I share a little bit of life, a little bit of style, and a little bit of everything in between.

feeds.title: College Fashionista
feeds.description: CollegeFashionista is a global community of students who are passionate about the latest styles, trends, and happenings at college campuses around the world. It allows students and other young adults to consume content of what their peers are wearing at college campuses around the world and gain valuable insight and tips on how to incorporate these looks into their wardrobes.

feeds.title: Sofiasolisb.com
feeds.description: Sofia Solis is a 19-year-old Fashion student and creator of Sofiasolisb.com, a blog about all things fashion, college & beauty! Follow to get her fashion & beauty tips as well for a guide on how to survive college.

feeds.title: College Fashion
feeds.description: College Fashion is the original and #1 fashion and beauty blog written by college students, for college students. Featuring fashion tips for students, the latest fashion trends, beauty tips, decor ideas, college lifestyle tips, and style advice for 20-somethings, CF is a college woman's daily source for all things fabulous.

feeds.title: College Dress Relief
feeds.description: College Dress Relief is a student advocacy group focusing on current fashion trends, sustainable fashion, diversity, and professional development. We contribute to an online student-run fashion and lifestyle blog geared towards Slippery Rock University students and the surrounding community. We are focused on relieving the daily stress college students endure by encouraging everyone to share their personal styles!

feeds.title: Styled by McKenz
feeds.description: Blog by McKenzie Morgan, just a twenty-something who's passionate about sharing her love for clothing and college life on the internet. Stick around for all sorts of fashion, fun, and everything in between!

feeds.title: coco bassey
feeds.description: Millennielle Coco Bassey is a blog by fashion expert Coco caters to the tastes of college students and Millenials. Follow this blog to get advice on what to wear to music festivals, how to get the best looks on a student's budget and the brands with the most enduring fashion status. Also, get tips on how to make the most of modern life.
